source_name: EUR-Lex legislation in force — Formex 4 explicit formulas

official_access.access_mode: official EUR-Lex Data Dump bulk export in FMX/Formex XML, one legal collection/language request at a time
official_access.authentication: EU Login is required for the Data Dump application
official_access.acquisition_rule: Use the official Data Dump/Cellar structured surfaces; do not scrape EUR-Lex document HTML page by page.

scope.collection: EUR-Lex legal acts in force (CELEX sector 3) and compatible Formex 4 exports
structures: FRACTION, ROOT, INTEGRAL, SUM, FUNCTION and other Formex formula components
scope.original_representation: serialized Formex 4 FORMULA XML subtree plus CELEX/language/context
exclusions: No reconstruction of prose thresholds, tables or image-only chemical structures in this lane
No algebraic equivalence claim during extraction

snapshot_policy.rule: Treat each completed Data Dump download request (collection + language + provider snapshot metadata) as one acquisition batch. Record the official request/download metadata, mirror every FMX XML object outside Git, compute byte size and SHA-256 per object, sort deterministically by relative path, and hash the canonical inventory. Use inventory-sha256:<digest> as source_snapshot; a request date alone is insufficient.

license_policy.scope: EU document reuse with document/third-party rights caveats
license_policy.rule: EUR-Lex states its data can be reused free of charge subject to its copyright notice. Commission Decision 2011/833 covers Commission/Publications Office documents but excludes material where reuse cannot be authorised because of third-party rights. Preserve CELEX, language and source attribution on every row; before public Internet Archive publication, apply a rights allowlist/audit to the selected dump. If reuse is uncertain, keep that material index-only or retain hashes/provenance without redistributing the formula payload. Never republish unrelated embedded third-party assets by default.

adapter.input: local mirror of official EUR-Lex Data Dump FMX/Formex XML
validation: Only explicit FORMULA elements are emitted
Serialized FORMULA XML, TYPE, CELEX, language and nearby context are preserved when available
No OCR or reconstruction is claimed by the extracted stage

lake.publication_gate: rights audit/allowlist for the selected Data Dump batch
